name: Ridgeline Roofing & Exteriors

hero.title: Roofs built for
hero.lead: Repairs, full replacements and storm claims across east Harris and Chambers counties. We get on the roof, show you the photos, and give you a written price before any work starts.
hero.imageAlt: Two roofers in safety harnesses working on a dark shingle roof

promises: Photos of every problem we find

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Leaks, missing shingles and flashing, fixed in a visit.
services.text: Leaks, lifted or missing shingles, failed flashing and worn pipe boots, found and fixed before the water reaches the ceiling.
services.imageAlt: A gloved hand pulling old roofing nails with a hammer
body: Most leaks start somewhere small: a cracked pipe boot, a nail that backed out, flashing that let go around a chimney. We trace the water from the attic to where it gets in, so the fix lands in the right spot the first time.
You get photos of what we found and a written price before we touch anything. Most repairs are done the same week, and many on the day of the inspection.
points: Leak tracing from the attic up
Flashing around chimneys, walls and skylights
Tarping when a storm is still coming

faqs.q: Can you match my existing shingles?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. We carry the common colors from the major manufacturers and bring a sample when the shingle is older or discontinued.

faqs.q: Is a repair or a new roof the better buy?
faqs.a: If the roof is under fifteen years old and the damage is in one area, a repair almost always makes sense. We will tell you plainly when it does not.

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: Full tear-off and a new roof, usually in one day.
services.text: A full tear-off down to the deck, new underlayment and the shingle you pick, installed by our own crew and cleaned up the same day.
services.imageAlt: A roofer tearing old shingles off a house roof
body: A new roof is a big purchase, so we walk you through it before anything is ordered: the shingle line, the color, the ventilation and the warranty, all written into one price.

On install day the crew tears off down to the deck, replaces any soft decking at the rate quoted, and has the new roof on before dark on most homes. Magnets sweep the yard and driveway for nails before we leave.
points: Soft decking replaced at a quoted rate
Synthetic underlayment and ice and water shield in the valleys
Ridge vents and attic ventilation checked
Yard and driveway swept for nails

faqs.q: How long does a replacement take?
faqs.a: Most homes are done in one day. Larger or steeper roofs can take two, and we tell you that when we quote.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home?
faqs.a: No. We need access to an outdoor outlet and the driveway, and we send photos when the job is finished.

services.title: Storm and Hail Damage
services.short: Hail and wind damage documented for your insurance claim.
services.text: Hail bruising, creased and blown-off shingles, and storm leaks, documented with photos your insurance adjuster can use.
services.imageAlt: A hand holding hailstones after a storm
body: Hail damage is hard to see from the ground, and wind-creased shingles often look fine until the next storm lifts them. We get on the roof, mark every hit, and photograph it so you know what is there before you call your insurance company.
If the damage is worth a claim, we meet your adjuster on the roof and point out what we found. If it is not, we say so and quote the repair.
points: Photo report you can send your insurer
Meeting your adjuster on the roof
Repair or replacement once the claim is approved

faqs.q: Will filing a claim raise my premium?
faqs.a: Storm claims are usually treated as acts of nature, but every policy is different. Ask your agent before you file; we will give you the photos either way.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay my deductible?
faqs.a: Yes. Texas law requires the homeowner to pay their deductible, and a contractor who offers to cover it is breaking that law.

services.title: Roof Inspections
services.short: A free, photo-documented look at your whole roof.
services.text: A free inspection of the whole roof: shingles, flashing, vents, gutters and the attic, with photos of anything that needs attention.
services.imageAlt: A roofer in a harness inspecting a steep roof
body: An inspection takes about forty-five minutes. We walk the roof, check the attic for daylight and water stains, and send you a photo report the same day.
Home buyers and sellers use the same report for a closing, and many owners book one every spring before hurricane season.
points: Full walk of the roof surface
Attic check for leaks and ventilation

services.title: Gutters
services.text: Seamless aluminum gutters made on site, leaf guards, and downspouts routed away from the slab.
services.imageAlt: Leaves collected in a gutter along a shingle roof edge
body: Gutters do most of their work in the few heavy storms each year, and a clogged or undersized run sends that water into the fascia and against the foundation.
We form seamless gutters on site to the length of each run, so there are fewer joints to leak, and pitch them so they drain.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: TPO, modified bitumen and metal roofs for business.
services.text: Flat and low-slope roofs for shops, offices and warehouses: TPO, modified bitumen and metal, plus repairs and maintenance plans.
services.imageAlt: A roofing crew walking a large white flat commercial roof
body: We work on low-slope roofs for small businesses, churches and light industrial buildings across the area, and schedule around your hours so the doors stay open.
A maintenance plan puts someone on the roof twice a year to clear drains, reseal penetrations and catch problems while they are still cheap.

claim.title: How a storm claim works
claim.text: Most homeowners file one roof claim in their life. Here is how it goes when we are on your side of it.

steps.title: Free inspection
steps.text: We check the roof and photograph every hail hit and lifted shingle.

steps.title: You file the claim
steps.text: If the damage is there, you call your insurer with our photo report in hand.

steps.title: Adjuster meeting
steps.text: We meet the adjuster on the roof and point out what we found.

steps.title: Approval and install
steps.text: Once the claim is approved, our crew replaces the roof, usually in a day.

steps.title: Final paperwork
steps.text: We send the invoice and completion photos your insurer needs to release the last payment.

materials.title: Shingles we install
materials.text: We install the major manufacturers' lines and register the warranty in your name.

projects.title: Wood shake to architectural shingle
projects.text: Worn cedar shake torn off, new decking where it had rotted, and a dark architectural shingle with ridge vents.
projects.imageAlt: A two-story home with dormers and a new brown shingle roof
projects.beforeAlt: Old cedar shakes split and curling before the tear-off

projects.title: Hail claim on a two-story home
projects.text: Hail bruising across three slopes, documented for the adjuster and replaced after the claim was approved.
projects.imageAlt: A two-story home with a new dark shingle roof over several gables
projects.beforeAlt: Weathered, cracked shingles on the old roof

projects.title: Re-roof before closing
projects.text: A buyer's inspection flagged the roof. We replaced it in one day so the sale closed on schedule.
projects.imageAlt: An aerial view of a single-story home with a new gray shingle roof

about.title: A Baytown crew, on Baytown roofs
text: Ridgeline started with one truck and a crew of three, doing repairs for neighbors after a hailstorm. The same owner still walks most of the inspections.
Every roof is installed by our own crew, not a subcontractor we met that morning, and the person who quotes your job is the one you call if anything comes up later.
about.imageAlt: Two roofers installing shingles on a steep roof

values.title: Our own crews
values.text: No day-labor subcontractors on your roof.

values.title: Photos, not pressure
values.text: You see what we see before you decide anything.

values.title: One written price
values.text: The number you sign is the number you pay.

inspection.title: What happens at a free inspection

steps.title: We call you back
steps.text: Usually the same day, to set a time that works.

steps.title: We check the roof
steps.text: About forty-five minutes on the roof and in the attic.

steps.title: You get the photos
steps.text: A photo report and, if work is needed, a written price.

reviews.author: Homeowner in Baytown
reviews.text: They found hail damage I never would have seen from the yard, met the adjuster, and had the new roof on in one day. The yard was cleaner than before they came.

reviews.author: Homeowner in Mont Belvieu
reviews.text: Had a leak over the kitchen for months. They traced it to a cracked pipe boot and fixed it the same afternoon for less than I expected.

reviews.author: Business owner in La Porte
reviews.text: Our shop roof ponded water every rain. They cleared the drains, patched the seams and now come out twice a year. No more buckets.
